name: Carbon dioxide
why_its_added: Makes drinks fizzy, and replaces air in packets so food stays fresh longer.

india.note: Permitted at GMP level - used as needed, no fixed numeric cap in the categories found.

usa.note: Generally Recognised As Safe (GRAS) for direct addition to food (21 CFR 184.1240)

means: No single-serving limit has been found for this substance. That is not the same as there being no risk from one large serving - it means nobody has published a number.

people_reports.rule: Reports are shown as reports. We count them. We never turn them into a health claim, and we never let them change the sourced facts above.

india_limits.food_category: Fermented milks (plain) heat treated after fermentation
Sterilized and UHT creams, whipping and whipped creams, and reduced fat creams (plain)
Peeled or cut minimally processed fruits
Vegetable juices(vegetable juices for industrial use, thermally processed vegetable juices, thermally processed tomato juice)
Concentrates of fruitjuices (concentrated fruit juices for industrial use)
Coffee, coffee /coffee substitutes, tea, herbal infusions, and other hot cereal and grain beverages, excluding cocoa
